note: Scarification (e50) counted as mechanical vegetation control; 'vegetation suppression' edges (e18,e23,e28,e29,e48) excluded because the method (mechanical vs herbicide) is not stated; diversity/richness and single-species abundance outcomes excluded as not composition.
Only nitrogen-addition (fertilizer) edges; no CO2 or air-chemistry cause among candidates.

e44 read via termination of stocking -> no backcross catches; e5 (hatchery share of return) and e20/e59 (stocked share of population) treated as fish-number outcomes, borderline. Coho abundance/biomass edges excluded: cause is not stated as a release.
Pond construction treated as wetland creation.
Tree-cover edge e11 left to canopy-shade class; vegetation-removal treatments (cutting, herbicide) excluded as interventions rather than competing vegetation; e60 is reversed.
Class mixes shade and light: more light -> more species (e19) and more tree cover/shade -> fewer species (e21) agree substantively but carry opposite signs under the rubric.

Only generic restoration causes kept; specific treatments (seeding, herbicide, ash/smoke, mowing, disturbance) and time-since-restoration / reference-vs-restored contrasts excluded. Native status of Carex, Eriophorum, Sphagnum, regenerating trees and wetland species assumed from context.
Sediment-dredging edges only report amphibian outcomes; no bird outcomes among candidates.

Acrotelm application, soil inoculum and added soil treated as soil amendments; transplant survival (Carex, Ledum, sedges, grasses/forbs) treated as seedling survival; mulch (e28) left to mulch class; scarification, soil mixing and soil-type contrasts excluded.
Mulch edges report only soil N, moisture, temperature or plant biomass; microbe/fungi outcomes come only from cover-soil treatments, which are not mulch.

Only DCA-axis/ordination or unsigned composition associations with soil moisture / water table. Excluded e11/e22/e46/e62 ('water min'/'water dif' undefined in text), e60 (richness, not composition), e25 (climatic P-PE, not soil wetness).
No candidate concerns visitor trampling or recreation; disturbance treatments, winter road clearances and road use are not instances.
No logging/harvest edge with a soil compaction or structure outcome; e35 is forest-to-fallow conversion, e19 soil loading, e28 salvage logging -> pH (chemistry).
No built stream/shoreline structure edge with a mammal outcome; weir edges concern lake sturgeon habitat, e8 woody debris windrows are not stream structures.
No temperature/warming edge with a predation, seed consumption or damage outcome.
Excluded experimental crayfish introduction (e1/e2/e6) as invasive-species addition rather than reintroduction/stocking; e3 outcome is diatoms, not invertebrates.
Scarification edges concern soil nutrients and temperature only; no erosion or sediment loss outcome.

Kept only burn-treatment edges whose outcome is a native taxon or native group (Camassia, Fragaria virginiana, Achillea/Ranunculus occidentalis, Eriophyllum, seeded forbs, native annuals/graminoids); nativity of species judged from common knowledge, not stated in sentences. Excluded non-native taxa (H. radicata, L. vulgare, Agrostis, Galium, Dactylis, nonnative groups), ambiguous Prunella vulgaris and moss, soil microbes (e13, e47), wildfire severity/history edges, and overall understory/canopy cover (e44, e54). SBG/MBG combine burning with herbicide.
No candidate links water table or water level to bare ground; bare-soil edges are driven by disturbance, and the lone water-level edge (e26) reports emergent vegetation area.

Only e12 reports total plant cover. Mulch edges on native-species cover (e8, e10, e47, e48, e53) and single-species cover (e22, e23, e27) were treated as other outcome classes. If native cover counts as overall plant cover, add them.
No pollution or contaminant cause links to CO2 exchange; e11 (NEP) is driven by revegetation of tailings, not by the contaminant.
Hatchery/captive-bred sockeye edges (e2, e4, e6) report genetic diversity (HE, allelic richness), not Shannon/evenness community diversity indices.
Excluded e7: its cause combines warm and dry conditions, and its outcome is a donor-site category, not bare ground cover.

Dead wood = woody debris and slash. Counted vascular plant cover (e24) as overall cover. Excluded moss, woody-plant and non-native cover, and tree-cover edges in rec.12546, which are not explicitly retained trees.
Excluded seeded or planted establishment (barley e13, Agropyron e19, Thuja e22), seedling growth/mortality edges, and bryophyte regeneration under water-level treatments (e23, e56).

Competition edges report individual seedling diameter or growth (e2, e9, e16, e25, e33, e57), which I read as tree growth, not stand structure or basal area. If seedling basal diameter counts, those edges consistently show competition reducing diameter.

e28 treats rusty crayfish as invasive, which is not stated in the sentence. Excluded e22 (algal pigment group abundance, not a population) and native-deer, coho and predator edges. Without e28 the answer would be increase/moderate.

Excluded non-tree outcomes (Glyceria, Onoclea, Alliaria, crops), nutrient/allocation/SLA/survival/regeneration outcomes. Cover crops treated as competing vegetation; e22 (lime + cover crop) is a compound cause. Removal/suppression edges sign-flipped.
Only candidates are winter road clearances (vehicle-road linear disturbance), judged not an instance of trampling & recreation. If winter roads count, e1 would be a null result (effect 0, low).

Kept only outcomes the text ties to native species. Excluded generic plant density/cover edges from rec.12106 (native status not stated), smoke/ash fire-cue treatments, non-native cover, richness/diversity, and pussytoes/bluegrass (native status not stated).

Excluded soil supply rates, liming soil chemistry, pore water, foliar biomass, TNC, RSR, 15N allocation/recovery. e16 signed -1 per sentence (stem K higher at lower rate). Some edges compare fertilizer regimes (exponential vs constant, F1 vs F2), signed as stated.
Engineered-structure edges concern macroinvertebrates, epilithon and CPOM in streams, not soil microbes; biochar edges are not in-stream/engineered structures.

Included grass and Iris seedling survivorship and shrub cutting survival as seedling survival; aspen leaf-litter cover treated as surface cover. Excluded hydroseeded cover, cover crops, seedbed mats, surface roughness, and density/establishment/growth outcomes.

Included cover soils, biochar/coke (OTU richness), substrate amendments; many are type-vs-type contrasts. Excluded smoke/ash fire cues, microaspect, surface disturbance, FPOM in streams, Shannon diversity/evenness-only outcomes, and PK substrate edges e39/e48.

No candidate has a temperature/microclimate cause with a composition outcome; nurse-plant edges have temperature as the outcome, and e59 (soil moisture vs ordination axis) is hydrology, not microclimate.
Only the round goby -> sculpin density edge fits; coho edges treat native fish as cause and non-fish outcomes.
Individual tree height/diameter growth and grass density excluded as not stand structure. e4 signed from the herd-reduction qualifier, though the sentence attributes the decline to a browsing legacy.
No candidate has a soil or litter invertebrate outcome.

Most edges compare planting variants (position, substrate, spacing) rather than planting vs none. Herbaceous transplant and grass/forb container edges excluded as not seedling/tree survival; e51 moderates.
Excluded vegetation/neighbor control edges whose method is not stated as mechanical (e13, e16, e27, e28, e49) and herbaceous transplant outcomes.
e19 excluded: its sentence is about seed-bank seedling emergence, not seed heads. Seed emergence/mortality of sown seeds and seed-bank density from mixed treatments excluded.
No candidate measures tree species composition or dominance; e28 species assemblages are on peat hummocks, not trees.
Liming edges (e5, e7, e8, e10, e18, e20, e35, e37, e42, e48, e58) excluded as liming is not fertilization; plant-tissue nutrient and benchmark-similarity/variability outcomes excluded.
Only water-table -> DOC edges fit. e4 is reversed (soil OC -> wet site); e18 inundation -> CO2 emissions excluded as a flux, not soil carbon; e35 is decomposition rate, not soil carbon.

Only mounding counted as soil preparation before planting. Cover soil placement/type and soil amendment edges (e12, e15, e22, e36, e57, e60, e48) excluded as reclamation cover soil or amendments, not site preparation; composition-only edges excluded.

Only mechanical release (cutting competing vegetation) counted; 'cutting intensity/cutting treatments' in the same study are overstory harvest cuts and are excluded. Effects follow the measured variable (higher WUE and Amax = +1), which indicates less stress, not more; direction 'increase' refers to these physiological measures.

Doubtful class fit: shrub cover and perennial grass cover taken as competing vegetation. Vegetation suppression and manual cutting edges excluded as control interventions (other classes); suppression edges also report richness (S) and FD with contradictory treatment rankings.
Many herbicide -> species richness edges (e2, e3, e7, e13, e14, e17, e20, e26, e33, e39, e50, e55) excluded: richness is not a Shannon/evenness diversity index.

Harvest edges from 10.1002/hyp.13580 (e5, e8, e13, e24, e27 decreased; e28, e33, e52, e59 no change) concern weighted usable area, i.e. fish habitat, not fish populations. If habitat counted: decrease, moderate.
No temperature/microclimate -> invasive cover edge. Non-native cover edges (e15, e33, e49) have cover-soil causes; e54 is reversed (Cirsium monoculture -> soil temperature).

All herbicide edges report cover of single species or groups (native, non-native forbs, grasses) or bare ground, not total vegetation cover. If bare ground counted inversely (e17 -1, e48 -1, e10 0): decrease, moderate.
No fire -> fish edge among candidates.

Excluded: plant tissue nutrient edges (e19, e35, e38, e46, e58, e80, e3), lake sediment (organic status not stated: e11, e65), cover soils/donor material (LFH, PMM, peat cover soil), pH/EC. Straw study edges partly describe year-to-year changes; e32 is no-straw so sign flipped.
e10 (time post-restoration -> NPP) excluded: NPP judged not a CO2-exchange measure; including it would give increase/moderate. e53/e57 same study tie -> internally mixed.
Plant-tissue nutrient outcomes excluded (not soil); liming excluded as not fertilization; till-only/PK-time-trend and similarity/variability outcomes excluded.
Candidates look incomplete: e15 sentence states biosolids did not affect soil C stock but no edge encodes it. Litter cover and microbial biomass C outcomes excluded.
No rewetting/hydrology-restoration edge with a bare soil/peat cover outcome.
Excluded e35 (stand age -> mature tree stocking, not regeneration), e54 (calendar time under deer browsing), stand height and treatment x time edges.
No trampling/recreation cause; winter road clearances judged linear disturbance, not trampling.
Only prescribed fire/burn treatments (not wildfire) or fire severity -> regeneration density; none with overall plant cover from wildfire.
e31 excluded: 'protective cover' is the straw itself, not Polytrichum cover. e45 excluded: amendments, not mulch.
Only understory cover treated as total vegetation cover; e3 canopy cover excluded; herb/shrub/native-only covers excluded.

Cause read as site/soil type, site status, water table depth; vegetation, amendment and restoration treatments excluded; moisture/temperature/bulk density not chemistry. e18 node says natural site EC increased but sentence says natural EC is one-third of restored, signed -1. e22 node says reference->P increased but sentence says P higher in restorations, signed -1. e21 flipped (shallower water table -> higher pH). e20/e21 are simulated tailings pH. e1/e45 excluded (unchanged cause, not negated).
No candidate links prescribed/controlled burning to functional trait composition; e5 cause is time since slashburning, e20/e23 are microbial abundance.
No candidate links burning to water table level.
e17/e31 compare soft- vs hard-release of captive-reared owls. Survival and effective population size edges excluded as not breeding success.

Removal/reduction and distance edges flipped to pollutant orientation (e28, e37, e45, e51-e53, e56, e65, e41, e49, e69). pH outcomes sign -1 under pollution while concentrations sign +1, hence mixed. Excluded: d13C, vitellogenin, sewage/sludge amendments, oil-exposure-duration time effects (e48, e73, e84), e22 (temporal stabilization).
No candidate links temperature or warming to animal condition, growth or health.
e1/e5 excluded (PK substrate incl. unamended, temporal decline). e11 excluded: its sentence reports cover, not richness. Density, cover, evenness, OTU (biochar) and seed-addition edges excluded.
e8/e14/e26 compare harvested debris sites (dispersed, piles, windrows) to uncut forest, so the debris effect is confounded with harvest. Diversity-only edges excluded.
No candidate concerns tree shelters/protection and soil or litter invertebrates; e16 fencing -> soil moisture only.

Water-addition/high-water watering treatments (e7,e9,e23,e44,e49,e58) judged irrigation, not water table/level; e1 water level -> moss (Warnstorfia/Sphagnum) regeneration success judged not seed germination/emergence; e56 'emergent vegetation' area is not emergence.
Fire edges (prescribed fire, wildfire) only reach soil nutrients/C content or recovery area, never CO2 exchange; CO2 flux edges have non-fire causes.
Shoot/root ratio and mycorrhizal short-root counts (e4,e10,e48) excluded as allocation/colonisation, not productivity.
No trampling/recreation cause; winter road clearance -> Simpson dominance edges (e31,e35,e52) judged roads/linear disturbance, not recreation.

Borderline excluded: e32 time since winter-road abandonment -> active layer depth (permafrost, not microclimate), e6 forest regrowth -> canopy openness (light/canopy), e50 March temperature trend since 1938 (calendar climate trend, not time since disturbance).

Time since recovery from acidification treated as time since disturbance. Excluded: elk time since release/reintroduction (e17,e31), calendar year (e8,e40,e43), nest age (e37), plant seedling survival (e13,e49), juvenile recruitment (e21,e35,e48).

Engineered-structure study (rra.1602) votes decrease vs reference streams; groin-vs-other-structure and structure-type contrasts given null (no presence/absence sign). Boulder clusters (f03-013) vote increase. Woody debris edges concern small mammals, not invertebrates.

Functional traits read as organism-level height/height increment and per-plant shoot mass; plot-level root mass (e3, e19), germination, cover and richness excluded. Wood chip incorporation is not surface mulch; e45 sentence does not support the mulch-site SLA claim. Slash cover treated as surface cover.
No candidates offered.

Tree cover taken as tree dominance; block-cut surfaces had more trees, post-vacuum sites less tree cover. Mounding, restoration and plant-community (non-tree) composition edges excluded. Candidates look thin for tree species composition.
e8 and e9 contradict each other for the same 1994 Tableland plots; study votes 0 by plurality. Cover soil, germination mat, density and cover edges excluded.
Richness edges (e29, e31, e32) treated as number of species, not diversity/evenness; moss layer transfer treated as diaspore transfer, not planting.

Planting-condition contrasts (site, substrate, seedling size, species, position, fertilization) excluded as not planting vs no planting. e40 subject years conflict with its sentence (other planting years lacked growth); kept as -1, making that study internally mixed. Few edges compare planted vs unplanted.
Woody debris survival edges concern small mammals; residual-tree edge (e25) is seedling stocking/density, not survival.
